reason: I count my drawer myself every night and my girls have been with me for years. If I make them take a selfie to check in and the app shows me cancelled bills, they will feel I am watching them like thieves, and I don't know a single owner or distributor using this.
objection: A selfie check-in will make my staff feel I don't trust them, and in a small parlour losing one good stylist hurts more than whatever the app catches. Also ₹4,999 upfront to a company nobody I know has tried.
would_change_my_mind: If two or three salon owners I know in my area were already using it happily, and I could switch off the selfie check-in and just use the billing and WhatsApp reminders.
